description: This file defines a Migration class for version 5.6.1 in the OrangeHRM system. It contains methods to update display field class names in the database during a migration, including fetching display field IDs by alias and updating their class names.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class that updates display field class names for specific field aliases as part of system upgrade to version 5.6.1.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration update logic by calling updateDisplayFieldClassNames.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, '5.6.1'.

methods.name: updateDisplayFieldClassNames
methods.description: Fetches display field IDs for specific aliases and updates their class names in the database.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldIdFromFieldAlias
methods.description: Retrieves the display_field_id for a given field alias from the database.

methods.name: updateDisplayFieldClassById
methods.description: Updates the class_name of a display field entry in the database based on its ID.
